articles.headline: José Mourinho hails Jude Bellingham but refuses Zinedine Zidane comparison
articles.description: José Mourinho called Jude Bellingham "one of the best players of his generation" on Friday, but refused to compare the England star with Real Madrid legend Zinedine Zidane.

articles.headline: Mourinho embarrasses his 'cousin' at Real Madrid press conference
articles.description: Jose Mourinho ended his Real Madrid press conference by embarrassing his 'cousin' in front of the gathered media.

articles.headline: Transfer rumors, news: Barça, Madrid jockey for position in Erling Haaland chase
articles.description: Barcelona and Real Madrid are positioning themselves for a move for Man City striker Erling Haaland. Transfer Talk has the latest.

articles.headline: Soccer's main character this week: Jude Bellingham is in a new stratosphere
articles.description: Why are goals trending up in Europe? Is it because Jude Bellingham can seemingly score them from anywhere? Bill Connelly takes a look at the week that was.

articles.headline: Vinícius Júnior praised by Jude Bellingham: Critics want 'excuse to hammer him'
articles.description: Jude Bellingham backed Vinícius Júnior to silence his critics after the winger shone in Real Madrid's 5-1 Champions League win over PSV Eindhoven on Tuesday.

articles.headline: Jude Bellingham: I don't care about the Ballon d'Or
articles.description: Jude Bellingham has said that team trophies are more important to him than winning the Ballon d'Or.

articles.headline: Mourinho: Bellingham is the best midfield player in the world
articles.description: José Mourinho gives Jude Bellingham the highest of prasise following Real Madrid's 5-1 victory against PSV Eindhoven.

articles.headline: Ryan Giggs bumped down list of oldest Champions League scorers
articles.description: Ivan Perišić became the fourth-oldest Champions League scorer by converting a first-half penalty kick in PSV Eindhoven's 5-1 loss to Real Madrid on Tuesday.

articles.headline: Jobe Bellingham teases Jude over wonder-goal: 'Off his shin!'
articles.description: Jobe Bellingham teased his brother Jude Bellingham after the Real Madrid star's outrageous goal in the Champions League on Tuesday, before handing him advice about facing Arsenal.

articles.headline: Bellingham: Being the best player in the world means nothing to me
articles.description: Jude Bellingham reacts to his goal for Real Madrid against PSV in the Champions League.

articles.headline: Bellingham credits Mourinho 'full stop' for stellar form after Madrid stunner
articles.description: Jude Bellingham praised José Mourinho for helping him reach career-best form after the midfielder scored a stunning goal in Real Madrid's 5-1 comeback win over PSV Eindhoven on Tuesday.

articles.headline: Burley: Bellingham is the best midfielder in the world
articles.description: The ESPN FC crew react to Real Madrid's 5-1 victory against PSV Eindhoven in the UEFA Champions League.

articles.headline: Real Madrid stay perfect in UCL after Bellingham ignites five-goal second half
articles.description: A long-range stunner from Jude Bellingham and Kylian Mbappé's double powered Real Madrid past PSV Eindhoven 5-1 for their fifth straight Champions League victory.

articles.headline: Champions League recap: Arsenal drop points vs. Dortmund, Madrid go top
articles.description: Borussia Dortmund earned a crucial point away at Arsenal, while Real Madrid got an easy win over PSV on the first day of Matchday 5 of the UEFA Champions League.

articles.headline: Champions League Power Rankings before MD5: Who's No. 1?
articles.description: The UEFA Champions League is going at full speed, and we're beyond the halfway point of the league phase. Injuries are starting to pile up. Where does your club rank?

articles.headline: Real Madrid's Mourinho: Vinícius Jr. 'doesn't have to be MVP' to deliver
articles.description: Mourinho has backed Vinícius Júnior to "return to his maximum potential" as Real Madrid face PSV Eindhoven in Champions League play.

articles.headline: Jude Bellingham 'swears a lot' but hailed as a 'leader' by Thibaut Courtois
articles.description: Thibaut Courtois praised in-form Jude Bellingham as a "leader on the field" ahead of Real Madrid's Champions League game with PSV Eindhoven.

articles.headline: Carlos Espí's 'most special' goal earns Real Madrid win and Rafael Nadal praise
articles.description: Real Madrid supersub Carlos Espí said his late goal against Celta Vigo was his "most special" yet after earning his team the win and praise from Rafael Nadal.

articles.headline: Bellingham & Espí rescue Real Madrid after Mbappé's missed penalty
articles.description: Real Madrid overcome Pablo Durán's early strike and Kylian Mbappé's missed penalty to win 2-1 over Celta Vigo, thanks to goals from Jude Bellingham and Carlos Espí.

articles.headline: Bellingham, Espí rescue Madrid after Mbappé's missed penalty
articles.description: Real Madrid came from behind to defeat Celta Vigo 2-1 and draw level on points with Barcelona at the top of LaLiga.
